behaviors.description: Select a real authenticator and pass exact repeated-option values when adding a remote.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent protected runtime and separately compiled wire-protocol service on the private bus.
behaviors.expected: Unconfigured authentication fails without deployment; the configured service receives the final value including an equals sign, issues the required token, and permits the exact protected commit.

behaviors.description: Enable and disable automatic authenticator installation through ordered remote-add flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent protected runtime, available authenticator app/runtime, and no activation service.
behaviors.expected: The last flag controls whether the exact candidate and runtime are installed; authentication still fails without service activation and protected payloads remain untouched.

mappings.rationale: Actual wire requests and independently gated transfers establish authenticator selection and exact option delivery.

surface_assertions.rationale: The selected real service supplies the token needed for the exact protected commit.
The service validates the final repeated key value, including its embedded equals sign.

mappings.rationale: Opposite flag orders produce different real candidate deployment sets, independently of outer authentication failure.

surface_assertions.rationale: A final grant causes actual installation of the independently known candidate and runtime.
A final revocation prevents candidate installation after an earlier grant.
